en.name: Academic research assistant
en.summary: Helps with literature reviews, paper analysis, and scholarly writing.

zh.name: 学术研究助手
zh.summary: 辅助文献综述、论文分析与学术写作。

zh.name: 算力预检
zh.summary: 跑实验前确认 GPU 等算力可用，不可用就停下，避免编造结果。

en.name: Compute pre-check
en.summary: Check that GPUs or other compute are available before experiments; stop instead of faking results.

en.name: Dataset discovery
en.summary: Find relevant datasets across HuggingFace Hub, OpenML, GitHub, and paper references.

zh.name: 数据集发现
zh.summary: 从 HuggingFace、OpenML 和 GitHub 查找任务相关数据集。

en.name: Single-cell initial analysis
en.summary: Run QC and exploratory analysis on single-cell data and produce an analysis report.

zh.name: 单细胞初步分析
zh.summary: 对单细胞数据进行质控、探索性分析并生成分析报告。

en.name: Code survey
en.summary: Acquire needed repositories and map paper concepts to their code implementations.

zh.name: 代码调研
zh.summary: 获取所需代码仓库，并将论文概念映射到具体实现。

en.name: Deep research
en.summary: Synthesize multi-source research with citations into an in-depth analysis.

zh.name: 深度调研
zh.summary: 综合多来源信息并附引用，形成深入的研究分析。

en.name: Experiment analysis
en.summary: Analyze experimental results and produce paper-ready results sections and visualizations.

zh.name: 实验结果分析
zh.summary: 统计分析实验结果，生成可用于论文的结果章节与图表。

en.name: Experiment development
en.summary: Plan the implementation, write code with judge feedback, and submit the final experiment run.

zh.name: 实验开发
zh.summary: 制定实现计划，在评审反馈下编写代码并提交实验运行。

en.name: AI image generation
en.summary: Generate or edit images with OpenAI gpt-image-2 or Gemini.

zh.name: AI 生图
zh.summary: 用 gpt-image-2 或 Gemini 生成与编辑图像。

en.name: Grant proposal
en.summary: Write, revise, and pre-review grant proposals for NSF, NIH, NSFC, and other agencies.

zh.name: 基金申请
zh.summary: 撰写、修改与模拟评审 NSF、NIH、国自然等基金申请书。

en.name: Humanize text
en.summary: Remove signs of AI-generated writing so text reads naturally.

zh.name: 去 AI 腔
zh.summary: 去除文本中的 AI 写作痕迹，使行文更自然。

en.name: Idea evaluation
en.summary: Score research ideas on five dimensions with multiple reviewer personas and a quality gate.

zh.name: 想法评估
zh.summary: 以多位评审视角从五个维度评估研究想法并把关质量。

en.name: Idea generation
en.summary: Generate literature-grounded research ideas and select one for evaluation.

zh.name: 想法生成
zh.summary: 基于文献生成多个候选研究想法，并择优交给评估。

en.name: Peer review
en.summary: Write structured, checklist-based peer reviews of manuscripts or grant proposals.

zh.name: 论文评审
zh.summary: 按清单对稿件或基金申请进行结构化同行评审。

en.name: Research pipeline planner
en.summary: Define a research project through conversation and generate its brief and task list.

zh.name: 研究流程规划
zh.summary: 通过对话明确研究项目，生成研究简报与任务列表。

en.name: Resource preparation
en.summary: Gather related repositories, dataset descriptions, reference codebases, and arXiv paper sources.

zh.name: 资源准备
zh.summary: 检索相关代码库、整理数据集说明并下载参考论文源码。

en.name: Overleaf sync
en.summary: Read, write, and sync LaTeX files in Overleaf projects from the command line.

zh.name: Overleaf 同步
zh.summary: 通过命令行读写并同步 Overleaf 项目中的 LaTeX 文件。

en.name: Rebuttal writing
en.summary: Draft and refine rebuttals to reviewers for top AI/CS conferences.

zh.name: 审稿回复
zh.summary: 为 AI/CS 顶会撰写并打磨针对审稿意见的回复。

en.name: Citation audit
en.summary: Verify citations in academic writing and avoid fabricated or inaccurate references.

zh.name: 引用核查
zh.summary: 核验参考文献的准确性，避免虚假或错误引用。

en.name: Academic presentation slides
en.summary: Create academic slide decks, and optionally demo videos, from research papers.

zh.name: 学术报告幻灯片
zh.summary: 根据论文制作学术报告幻灯片，可选生成演示视频。

zh.name: ML 顶会论文写作
zh.summary: 按 NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR 等会议要求写论文，含 LaTeX 模板和引用核验。

en.name: ML paper writing
en.summary: Write NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR-style papers with LaTeX templates and citation checks.

en.name: Paper deep dive
en.summary: Analyze a single paper in depth and produce structured notes with figures.

zh.name: 论文精读
zh.summary: 深度分析单篇论文，生成含图表的结构化笔记。

en.name: Scientific writing
en.summary: Write scientific manuscripts in full paragraphs, from outline to finished prose.

zh.name: 科学写作
zh.summary: 以完整段落撰写科学论文，先列提纲再成文。
